fact: L'Express reports the health minister's parliamentary answer that the e-Health system, in test since 23 August 2025, is operational at New Flacq Hospital and several primary care facilities of that region, that by 30 April 2026 it had recorded more than 126,000 patient registrations, 225,000 visits and 221,000 medical consultations, and that Jawaharlal Nehru Hospital is to follow by September 2026, SSRN Hospital in March 2027 and Dr A.G. Jeetoo and Victoria hospitals no earlier than December 2027.
title: E-Health : Le ministre Bachoo promet une accélération du chantier
